searchText: Hi so i have a question regarding the consensus alghorithm PoW I have written a Proof of Work alghorithm (very simple and basic one) where it mines blocks and calculates new hash everytime Ther algorithm also have difficulty function which can increase/decrease the difficulty based on input Now im a bit confused here, when i google "Bitcoin current mining difficulty" it says `29.9 T` Which apparently takes 10 minutes and 12 seconds. In my algorithm, when i enter 15 as difficulty, it ALOT more than 10 minutes, been mining 20 minutes ago and still nothing So, i assume i have missunderstood the difficulty? if you would like me to clarify please ping! thanks ~~That is 29.9 terahashes to find a solution on average I believe.~~ How long that takes is a function of how many hashes the network is generating per second. I'm not sure what that 29.9T represents, given that the Bitcoin network is generating Exahashes every second. I *believe* it's just about the header difficulty bits, so that would actually correlated closely with how many hashes you could expect to do to mine a block <@741734991767142470> it depends on how you implement it, and what that 15 value means
